findings_fixed.resolution: Added the global mg-state class to the unreadable-image placeholder while retaining data-component, data-state, data-tone, public resource ID, and content checksum metadata.
Mapped document attachments to the supported studio accent and protected data snapshots to the supported archive accent.

unverified_items: Authenticated browser, responsive layout, assistive-technology, and runtime rendering behavior were not exercised.
Document URL, checksum, field ordering, and content preservation were checked by scoped source inspection and TypeScript compilation, not by dedicated end-to-end execution.

checks: The unreadable-image root carries mg-state and retains its required data attributes and resource metadata.
Attachment and protected snapshot accents are studio and archive, both declared by the six-accent contract.
No CSS edit was needed; the existing CanonicalDocumentRenderer module styles were preserved.
